name: minions
description: Connect Claude Code to the Minions MCP server.

watch_mode.title: Watch tasks
watch_mode.description: When you create, adopt, start or resume a task here: ask whether to watch it for things that need you (ask), start watching without asking (auto), or do nothing (off). /watch always works.

watch_reminder_minutes.title: Watch reminder (minutes)
watch_reminder_minutes.description: Remind you again, with a desktop notification, while a watched task still needs you after this many minutes. 0 turns reminders off.
